policy.geometry: Six original GLBs preserved bytewise. Muscles/organs retain original binary buffers and graph/accessor prefixes exactly with 123 reviewed missing source surfaces appended. Also 160 missing lymphoid objects exported. No bounds-only identity aliases or duplicate source-candidate exports.
policy.identities: Converted systems use exact source/raw renderable node names. Existing exact display metadata retained, unique trim-only match metadata transferred. No guessed translation.
policy.omissions: Helper labels and zero-face/no-target catalog rows are explicitly omitted. Unresolved historical source identities are recorded, not declared absent.
policy.neighbors: 30 nearest decoded world-space vertex AABBs, Euclidean box separation in metres rounded to 4 decimals. Insertions excluded from sources and candidates, as in the legacy pipeline. Stable catalog-order tie break. This is not anatomical contact or surface distance.
policy.coverage: Every original source object and every original catalog row has one decision. Exact-name matches are structural evidence, not a claim of anatomical surface equivalence.

reviewed_source_candidates.limitation: Nearest-surface measurements support reviewed identity decisions, not a universal anatomical-equivalence threshold. Remaining unreviewed source identities stay unresolved.

files.preservation: Original binary chunk and nodes/meshes/accessors/bufferViews prefixes preserved exactly; verified source additions appended.
